name: item
title: Item
description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Item: a list row with a media square, a title, a description and actions at the end. Variants: default (frameless row), outline (a 2px ink case), muted (a 1px fine ink line on paper with a 6px tone band on the start edge, outside the text; no inner tone frame, so it never reads as disabled). Sizes default, sm, xs. Media is a 40px square case with a 2px ink frame. Titles are lettering; descriptions take the row's colour. Pass interactive for a row that is clicked: a frameless row inverts to ink on hover (G3), a framed or muted row thickens its line by 1px. Disabled: dashed frame with a tone frame and the label on paper. Also ItemGroup (a list), ItemSeparator (a fine ink line), ItemHeader and ItemFooter.
docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/item". It wraps your own components/ui/item, so Radix and Base UI both work. Items are plain elements: to make a whole row a link, wrap it in an anchor (block) and set interactive on the Item.

meta.tagline: A list row or a case, with a square media and lettering titles.
meta.usage:
import { Item, ItemMedia, ItemContent, ItemTitle, ItemDescription, ItemActions } from "@/components/ui/manga/item"

<Item variant="outline" interactive>
  <ItemMedia>
    <BookOpen />
  </ItemMedia>
  <ItemContent>
    <ItemTitle>Vol. 1 · The long night</ItemTitle>
    <ItemDescription>Twelve chapters, two unread.</ItemDescription>
  </ItemContent>
  <ItemActions>
    <ChevronRight />
  </ItemActions>
</Item>

props.description: default: frameless row. outline: 2px ink case. muted: 1px fine line with a 6px tone band on the start edge.

props.name: size
props.description: Padding and gap of the row.
